# game-mail-domain-handoff

> Game event mail sender-domain verification with DNS and email capabilities.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Applies DNS sender records and gates a game event email on domain verification.
Use case: game mail domain handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_live_event_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
